headline.en: Keep the editable project behind each motion card.
headline.zh: 为每张动效卡片保留可编辑项目。

sub.en: KineCard turns a title and text lines into a timed card animation, keeping card.yaml, render.json and the HTML/CSS/JS template available for later edits.
sub.zh: KineCard 将标题与文字要点转成定时卡片动画，并保留 card.yaml、render.json 与 HTML/CSS/JS 模板，供后续修改。

body.en: YAML and template sources remain available after export.
body.zh: 导出后仍可使用 YAML 与模板源。

body.en: Templates expose a deterministic seek function.
body.zh: 模板暴露确定性 seek 函数。

body.en: The linter reports estimated overflow before capture.
body.zh: 检查器在截图前报告估计溢出。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: The included script creates a complete one-card project, renders six small preview frames and saves docs/demo-preview.mp4. The configured animation timeline is 1400ms; six frames at 4fps produce a 1500ms video.
note.zh: 随仓脚本创建完整单卡项目，渲染六帧小型预览并保存 docs/demo-preview.mp4。配置动画时间线为 1400ms；六帧按 4fps 编码得到 1500ms 视频。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: Render an original one-card project through Chromium and ffmpeg at 360x640 and 4fps, with a 1400ms animation timeline, saving docs/demo-preview.mp4. Six encoded frames yield a 1500ms media duration; no platform upload or cross-machine byte-identity claim.

body.en: The included script creates a complete one-card project, renders six small preview frames and saves docs/demo-preview.mp4. The configured animation timeline is 1400ms; six frames at 4fps produce a 1500ms video.
body.zh: 随仓脚本创建完整单卡项目，渲染六帧小型预览并保存 docs/demo-preview.mp4。配置动画时间线为 1400ms；六帧按 4fps 编码得到 1500ms 视频。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/kinecard.git
cd kinecard
npm ci
npm run build
npx playwright install chromium

limitations.en: Rendering requires a compatible Playwright Chromium and ffmpeg. Installing dependencies or a browser may require network access.
limitations.zh: 渲染需要兼容的 Playwright Chromium 与 ffmpeg；安装依赖或浏览器可能需要联网。

limitations.en: Deterministic seek timestamps do not guarantee byte-identical video across operating systems, browser versions or encoders.
limitations.zh: 确定性 seek 时间戳不保证跨操作系统、浏览器或编码器生成逐字节相同视频。

limitations.en: Safe-zone and duration checks use repository presets and estimated text widths, not a live platform specification or complete visual-layout validation.
limitations.zh: 安全区和时长检查使用仓库预设与估计文字宽度，不是实时平台规范或完整布局验证。

limitations.en: The short demo uses 360x640 at 4fps to keep reproduction small; normal presets can render 1080x1920 at higher frame rates.
limitations.zh: 短示例使用 360x640、4fps 以降低复现成本；常规预设可使用 1080x1920 与更高帧率。

body.en: A rendered video is difficult to revise without its source. A small project directory preserves the content, timing and template so one card can be changed and rendered again.
body.zh: 没有源文件的视频很难修订。小型项目目录保留内容、时序和模板，单张卡片便可修改后再次渲染。

body.en: The schema loader validates content and render settings. The linter estimates horizontal text overflow and duration against bundled presets. Playwright drives window.KineCard.seek(tMs) and captures frames; ffmpeg encodes those PNGs as H.264. Project export retains the editable source.
body.zh: schema 加载器校验内容和渲染设置；检查器根据随仓预设估计水平文字溢出与时长。Playwright 调用 window.KineCard.seek(tMs) 并截图，ffmpeg 将 PNG 编码为 H.264；项目导出保留可编辑源。

body.en: The schema loader validates content and render settings. The linter estimates horizontal text overflow and duration against bundled presets. Playwright drives window.KineCard.seek(tMs) and captures frames; ffmpeg encodes those PNGs as H.264. Project export retains the editable source.
body.zh: schema 加载器校验内容和渲染设置；检查器根据随仓预设估计水平文字溢出与时长。Playwright 调用 window.KineCard.seek(tMs) 并截图，ffmpeg 将 PNG 编码为 H.264；项目导出保留可编辑源。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: card.yaml owns title, optional subtitle, lines, palette and platform. render.json owns fps, size, title/per-line/outro timing and fractional safe zones. Templates expose seek(tMs). Built-in templates are minimal, spotlight and mono; font assets retain their separate OFL license.
body.zh: card.yaml 定义 title、可选 subtitle、lines、palette 与 platform。render.json 定义 fps、size、标题/逐行/结尾时序及比例安全区。模板暴露 seek(tMs)。内置模板为 minimal、spotlight 与 mono；字体保留独立 OFL 许可。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
node dist/cli.js render examples/card.yaml -t minimal -o out.mp4
node dist/cli.js init my-card -t spotlight
node dist/cli.js render my-card
node dist/cli.js render examples/card.yaml --project editable-card
